top_signals.title: Jefferies Says Found Fraud in $900 Million of Radiant Deals
top_signals.summary: A Jefferies-run fund said in court proceedings that it has evidence of alleged fraudulent conduct by iron ore traders Radiant World and Sapphire Minmetals in receivables-financing deals with a face value of almost $900 million.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
